title: Welcome to ConfigForge
intro: ConfigForge works in two modes. Pick whichever fits how you'll use it. You can switch later from Configuración.

author.title: Author baselines anywhere
author.body: Editar, diferencias, comparar, and export OSConfig manifiestos on any OS. No extra installs needed.

deploy.title: Author + implementar on this machine
deploy.body: Texto localizado: Windows or Linux. Needs OSConfig instalado locally to apply or audit baselines against this device.
